prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Reference is Esk's turnaround. The same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. Produce one SIDE VIEW separated puppet parts sheet, a 4-column 2-row grid of equal square cells, no grid lines or labels. Every part completely detached, centred in its own cell with broad transparent space around it. Facing RIGHT. Row 1: (1) complete head and pointed hood with goggles, open eye, fur ruff and neck stub; (2) complete coat torso ONLY from scarf collar to fur hem, NO head NO arms NO legs; (3) trailing red scarf tail ONLY; (4) near straight arm with blue sleeve, elbow patch, grey fur cuff, brown mitten. Row 2: (1) far straight arm in one darker tone, grey cuff and brown mitten; (2) near straight trouser leg with knee patch and big boot pointing RIGHT; (3) far straight trouser leg and right-pointing boot one darker tone; (4) empty transparent cell. Paint full rounded top caps on limbs, including hidden area: caps extend past shoulder/hip joint so rotation opens no gaps. Arms straight and rigid, no bent elbows. Legs straight rigid. Dark-brown outlines. Limb and torso plain large flat fills, do not over-texture.
